annotation.title_clean: Presupuestos Mínimos para la Promoción del desarrollo de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en la República Argentina
annotation.title_en: Minimum Standards for the Promotion of the Development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the Argentine Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Giudici, Silvana (Diputada Nacional), Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.venue: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill by Deputy Silvana Giudici setting minimum standards to promote AI development, declaring it of strategic national interest. It sets guiding principles, bans certain biometric categorization and manipulative systems, requires labelling of realistic generative content, and creates a promotion council. It favours flexible, self-regulatory oversight.
key_provisions_or_claims: Declares AI development of national strategic interest
Sets guiding principles: inclusive growth, human rights, privacy, transparency, robustness, accountability
Prohibits biometric categorization inferring sensitive traits and manipulative persuasion systems
Requires labelling/watermarking of realistic generative AI content
Creates a Council for AI Promotion and Development with annual review; risk levels high/moderate/minimal
